verse.name: v1a
verse.lines: Will you come and follow me if I but call your name?

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines: Will you go where you don't know and never be the same?

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Will you let my love be shown?
Will you let my name be known?

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines: Will you let my life be grown in you and you in me?

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines: Will you leave yourself behind if I but call your name?

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines: Will you care for cruel and kind and never be the same?

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
Will you risk the hostile stare?
Should your life attract or scare?

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines: Will you let me answer prayer in you and you in me?

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines: Will you let the blinded see if I but call your name?

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines: Will you set the prisoners free and never be the same?

verse.name: v3c
verse.lines:
Will you kiss the leper clean
And do such as this unseen?

verse.name: v3d
verse.lines: And admit to what I mean in you and you in me?

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines: Will you love the "you" you hide if I but call your name?

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines: Will you quell the fear inside and never be the same?

verse.name: v4c
verse.lines:
Will you use the faith you've found
To reshape the world around?

verse.name: v4d
verse.lines: Through my sight and touch and sound in you and you in me?

verse.name: v5a
verse.lines: Lord your summons echoes true when you but call my name

verse.name: v5b
verse.lines: Let me turn and follow you and never be the same

verse.name: v5c
verse.lines:
In Your company I'll go
Where Your love and footsteps show

verse.name: v5d
verse.lines: Thus I'll move and live and grow in you and you in me.
